status: Post-result diagnostic; historical test outcomes have previously been inspected. No new confirmatory claim.
population: All cold_payer rows in the existing held-out December 5 sample, not handpicked examples
threshold: Use existing exported validation-only isotonic calibrator and threshold, unchanged
primary: Report failure warnings, missed failures and warnings on successful transactions at the deployed thresholds
sensitivity: Hypothetical equal fee F per failed attempt and opportunity cost C per blocked success; report TP-(C/F)*FP for C/F in [0,1,5,10]. These are dimensionless scenarios, not measured fees saved.
comparison: Context model minus payer/read-only baseline under the same fixed recipe; paired one-hour cluster bootstrap, seed 1729, 1000 draws
preflight: Unavailable in source: incremental benefit beyond preflight cannot be identified. Zero incremental benefit remains consistent with these data.
no_tuning: Do not change existing deployed thresholds, models, calibration, population or cost ratios based on this result
cost_threshold_followup: Exploratory fixed decision rule: for each predeclared positive ratio r in [1,5,10], warn when calibrated p >= r/(1+r), the expected-cost threshold under equal failure fee F and blocked-success cost C=rF. Report all ratios, including abstention. These assumptions are unverified; do not select a winning ratio from test outcomes.
